notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- Checkpoint no longer required holding down hotkey.
- Probably fixed issue with character falling through the floor.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- Removed 660 blank achievements.
- [strike]Fixed a bug where player randomly fall through floor.[/strike]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
- Added 6 new levels.
- Press [Tab] to switch camera.
- Hold [C] to create a checkpoint. (Hotkeys can be remapped in options)
- Changing an option is now instantly takes effect.
- Allow numpad key binding.
- Changed some part of level 13.
- Some UI adjustments.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- Added keyboard remapping.
- Partial controller support. (Use mouse to navigate menu)
-  [strike]Fixed bug causing fall and restart loop.[/strike]

notes.title: Update

- Removed floor texture.
